svg.text: SPY: 100 RSI rungs (own 3-year percentile) — middle 20-session result, with its 90% band
any day 1.39% · a rung is 1% of days · 14 rungs read as "different from any day" at 10%, about 10 expected by luck · surviving a 10% false-discovery check: 0
rung 1 = most oversold 1% of days · rung 100 = most overbought
p-value per rung (log scale): the chance of a gap this size by luck · above the 0.10 line looks "real" alone
false-discovery line: after 100 tests the smallest p must be under 0.001
